capabilities: Preview clicked images in a popup with zoom and full-screen mode
Move images by dragging or keyboard arrow keys
Rotate, flip, and invert image colors from toolbar or menu
Copy an image from the popup
Switch between all images in a note via a gallery navbar
extras: Docs also exist in Simplified Chinese; configuration options (pin mode, gallery navbar colors, modifier keys) are set on the plugin settings page.
problem: Obsidian's built-in image handling only shows images inline, with no zoom, pan, rotate, or comparison tools when viewing them.
summary: Image viewer that pops up clicked images for zooming, dragging, rotating, flipping, inverting colors, copying, with a per-note gallery navbar.
